nodes.name: Trigger CRM Booking
nodes.notes: Disabled: the AI Brain workflow already triggers CONFIRM_BOOKING once the booking is complete. Enabling this as well sends a duplicate confirmation on every booking-intent turn, including incomplete ones.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Missed Escalation Alert
nodes.notes: Alerts the manager on WhatsApp when a caller asked for a human but no valid escalation number was configured. Needs ESCALATION_ALERT_WHATSAPP and an approved WATI template 'missed_escalation_alert'.

nodes.name: Verify Twilio Signature (Incoming)
nodes.notes: Checks X-Twilio-Signature. Set TWILIO_SIGNATURE_MODE=log for the first test calls, then enforce.

nodes.name: Verify Twilio Signature (Turn)
nodes.notes: Checks X-Twilio-Signature. Set TWILIO_SIGNATURE_MODE=log for the first test calls, then enforce.

nodes.name: Check Caller Handoff
nodes.notes: Reads the guest's row in the Handoffs sheet. No row or a Sheets error both mean 'not paused'.

nodes.name: Open Handoff
nodes.notes: Pauses automated WhatsApp follow-ups for this guest and routes their next call straight to staff (Handoffs sheet).
